in_marathi.name: Rupchand
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Rich in wealth and prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rupchand हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rupchand is derived from the Sanskrit words 'rup' meaning form or wealth and 'chand' meaning lord or ruler. The name signifies being rich in wealth and prosperity, and also having the power and ability to rule.
